subject: APAC maintenance: temporary P2 SLA window carveout request (BlueHarbor)
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Li <anna@blueharbor.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 9 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: APAC maintenance: temporary P2 SLA window carveout request (BlueHarbor)

Hi Anna —

Quick heads-up: we have a scheduled infrastructure maintenance in APAC to migrate a subset of serving nodes (planned capacity reshuffle + OS patching). Window: 2026-01-24 00:00 to 2026-01-26 08:00 UTC (local APAC overnight). During the window we'll have rolling restarts that may temporarily increase response times for some background jobs and degrade visibility for non-critical alerts.

To avoid unnecessary noise and churn for BlueHarbor, we'd like to request a temporary carveout on the P2 response SLA for the APAC maintenance window: extend P2 target from our standard 4 hours to 8 hours for incidents explicitly flagged as maintenance-impact during this period. P1 commitments remain unchanged.

Attached: maintenance_runbook (full step plan) and an SLA-exception-form for your records.

Proposed mitigations we will run:
- Dedicated 24/7 on-call coverage for the migration (on-call rotations attached).
- Immediate fallback to warm-capacity in another region for customer-facing routing if latency exceeds hard threshold.
- Named escalation contacts (Ben and Karthik) plus a dedicated incident bridge.

Ask: can BlueHarbor review and confirm whether you can accept a temporary P2 extension for that window, and whether you require a formal signed waiver and a bill/credit proposal? If you prefer a different carveout (different window or threshold), we can adjust.

Thanks — and sorry for the inconvenience; we want this migration to be low-friction for you.

— Priya
Priya Natarajan
Senior Manager, Customer Support 
Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.ai

From: Anna Li <anna@blueharbor.com>

Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 10:18:00 +0800
Subject: Re: APAC maintenance: temporary P2 SLA window carveout request (BlueHarbor)

Thanks Priya — appreciate the early notice. A couple quick clarifications before we route for internal sign-off:

1) Can you confirm the precise list of customer-facing endpoints / regions that might see increased latency? We need that for our ops runbooks.
2) What is your proposed customer credit calculation if the extended P2 is invoked and an incident qualifies (hours impacted × % of monthly charge)?
3) Please confirm the escalation path: who will be on the incident bridge for P1 vs P2 and what is the expected time-to-bridge after detection.

If you can share a short appendix answering those three points we can expedite our internal approval. We’ll likely require a signed waiver (legal) but want ops to confirm first.

Best,
Anna Li
Head of Platform Reliability
BlueHarbor Inc.
anna@blueharbor.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Anna Li <anna@blueharbor.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: RE: APAC maintenance: temporary P2 SLA window carveout request (BlueHarbor)

Priya / team — looping in operational details per Anna’s questions. Short answers:

1) Impacted endpoints: API gateways in ap-southeast-1 and ap-northeast-1 only (customer traffic will still be routed to other regions unless a threshold is breached). We do NOT expect control plane reductions. Specific hostnames listed in the runbook (section 3.2).

2) Credit proposal: if an incident is classified as P2 and caused by the maintenance window AND customer accepts the carveout, we propose a pro-rata credit calculated as (hours_of_degraded_service / hours_in_billing_period) * 5% of monthly invoice for that period, capped at 15% for the maintenance window. This is a standard, one-time maintenance credit proposal. We can convert to a fixed credit amount if BlueHarbor prefers that.

3) Escalation / incident bridge:
- Detection: automated alerts to SRE.
- Time-to-bridge: goal within 15 minutes for P1, 60 minutes for P2 (during maintenance window only).
- On-bridge roster: Ben Carter (SRE lead), Karthik Iyer (infra), Soojin Lee (customer escalation), backup: Marissa Cole.
- Contactable via dedicated bridge: +1 650-555-8000 / meet.google.com/rw-infra-ops

I’m attaching the SUP-4521 ticket with proposed bridge owners and the fallback routing playbook. We should also confirm whether BlueHarbor wants a permanent change on their account or a one-off exception — my preference is a one-off signed waiver tied to this maintenance.

— Ben
Ben Carter
SRE Manager, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Li <anna@blueharbor.com>

Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 12:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: APAC maintenance: temporary P2 SLA window carveout request (BlueHarbor)

Anna — thanks for the quick review and Ben for the specifics.

Summary / ask for BlueHarbor:
- Scope: ap-southeast-1 and ap-northeast-1 only (per runbook section 3.2).
- Credit: pro-rata formula (hours/period) * 5%, cap 15% for window — we can convert to fixed credit if you prefer.
- Escalation: 15 min bridge for P1, 60 min bridge for P2 (maintenance window). On-bridge roster named above.
- Duration: 2026-01-24 00:00 to 2026-01-26 08:00 UTC.

If you’re good with the items above, please sign the attached SLA-exception-form and return. Once we have the signed waiver we’ll post a maintenance calendar invite and provision a dedicated bridge for the window. Legal will circulate final text if required.

Note: we’ll run a pre-cutover smoke test the evening before and notify you 24 hours in advance.

Thanks — Priya

On a related ops note: Marissa / Soojin, please ensure the monitoring runbook includes the BlueHarbor account filters so they don’t see duplicate alerts. Mark action: SUP-4521 updates before Jan 20.
